en.abdullah-al-shahin: (10) Muhammad bin Hammam and Muhammad bin al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Jumhoor narrated from al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Jumhoor from his father from Suma’a bin Mihran from Salih bin Maytham and Yahya bin Sabiq that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said: “
The hasteners will perish and those nearest to Allah will be saved! After distress there will be a wonderful deliverance!”
